categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of automotive glass assembly components. Main products include windshield installation components, side window glass lifting components, corner window glass assembly components and other automotive parts. The company has developed into the largest domestic manufacturer of injection-molded and extruded automotive glass assembly components, serving major automotive glass manufacturers including Fuyao Glass, Saint-Gobain, Asahi Glass, and Vitro.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies in product development and manufacturing processes. Key technologies include: automotive glass component noise reduction technology, anti-warping technology, integrated edge strip molding technology, camera bracket anti-glare and anti-fogging technology, flush-type side window guide rail technology, and self-locking side window glass bracket technology. Manufacturing processes include edge strip aluminum tape online welding, high-precision cutting technology, and flexible automation production technology. The company utilizes ERP, MES, APS, WMS and other digital management systems for production control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company primarily serves major automotive glass manufacturers including Fuyao Glass (accounting for 62.46% of 2024 revenue), Saint-Gobain, Asahi Glass, Vitro, and Yaohuang Glass. The company also serves automotive OEMs including Great Wall Motors and Dongfeng Nissan. Products are widely applied in the automotive glass field for both new energy vehicles and traditional fuel vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Qinhuangdao, Hebei Province. It has established a global supply chain presence serving major automotive glass manufacturers worldwide. In 2024, domestic sales accounted for 72.42% of revenue while overseas sales represented 27.58%, with significant operations in North America and Europe through subsidiary KELI AUTOMOTIVE PARTS, INC.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the automotive supply chain as a Tier-1 supplier of automotive glass assembly components. It supplies directly to major automotive glass manufacturers (Tier-1 suppliers) who then supply to automotive OEMs (Tier-0). The company also directly supplies some automotive OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) expanding market share in automotive glass assembly components through cost leadership and quality advantages; (2) developing new energy vehicle-related technologies and products; (3) expanding international market presence; (4) developing new business segments including automotive body decoration components; (5) pursuing emerging opportunities in new energy battery materials and low-altitude economy sectors. R&D investments totaled 32.93 million yuan in 2024, representing 5.38% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive glass assembly components to automotive glass manufacturers and OEMs. Revenue is recognized when products are delivered to customers and control is transferred. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with framework agreements establishing quality standards and payment terms, with specific orders placed through SRM systems or email. Other business revenue includes tooling services and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest domestic manufacturer of injection-molded and extruded automotive glass assembly components. The industry is characterized by numerous small-scale competitors with limited product ranges. The company has no direct A-share listed competitors with identical products and applications. The company has established strong competitive advantages through superior technology, quality, cost efficiency, and customer responsiveness, earning recognition as an excellent supplier from major customers like Fuyao Glass.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized automotive components manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 611.7 million yuan, representing 25.41% growth from 487.8 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to parent company was 150.2 million yuan in 2024, up 9.59% from 137.1 million yuan in 2023. The company completed its IPO in July 2024, raising 458.6 million yuan in net proceeds. Total assets grew 121.09% to 1.38 billion yuan by year-end 2024. The company demonstrates strong profitability with net profit margins around 24.5%.
